metadata.name: Chiikawa Soundtrack
metadata.description:
Replaces the game's music with the soundtrack of the anime [b]Chiikawa[/b] (ちいかわ).
[h1]REQUIRES[/h1] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1933285222]Soundtrack Menu[/url] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [i]OR[/i] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2491006386]Music Mod Callback (Repentance/Rep+)[/url] — one, not both [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Mod Config Menu[/url], to select the soundtrack [/list]
[h1]HOW TO USE[/h1] Start a run, then open the Mod Config Menu (F10 or L) and go to [b]Set Soundtrack[/b] → [b]Chiikawa[/b].
The soundtrack registers itself when a run begins, so it will not appear in the menu until you have started one.
You can also pick it per-track under [b]Custom[/b], mixing Chiikawa music with any other soundtrack you have installed.
[h1]WHAT IS COVERED[/h1] All music and jingles. Some tracks are reused across related slots. There are in total 16 pieces of music used in the mod.
Without REPENTOGON the title screen, run-start and nightmare jingles are not controllable by any soundtrack mod, so they are unchanged.
[h1]NOTES[/h1] Every track is loudness-matched so the volume does not change from floor to floor. The mix sits a little below the vanilla soundtrack, so you may want to raise the music slider a notch after switching to it.
All music belongs to its original rights holders. This mod is a fan work and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
